# zawk

> zawk is an implementation of the AWK language written by Rust, and it includes a standard library for text, math etc.

Things to remember to write awk script with zawk:

- standard library: text, math, datetime, crypto, parser, encode/decode, ID, KV, SQLite/MySQL, Redis/NATS etc.
- csv/tsv/jsonl/parquet built-in support with `zawk -i csv/tsv/jsonl/parquet`
- JSON Lines support with `zawk -i jsonl '{ print $FI["name"] }'`: keys of the first record populate `FI`, nested values keep raw JSON text
- f-strings for string interpolation: `f"SELECT * FROM {table} WHERE id = {$1}"`; placeholders are expressions (`{name}`, `{$1}`, `{NR+1}`, `{toupper($2)}`; write `\"` for a quote inside) with an optional format spec (`{price:.2f}`, `{name:>10}`, `{n:05d}`, `{s:*^9}`, `{r:.1%}`); `{{`/`}}` are literal braces; `f"..."` is never the variable `f` concatenated with a string, write `f "..."` for that; likewise `r"..."`/`r#"..."#` is a raw string, never the variable `r` followed by a string
- zawk is the successor of frawk, and all frawk scripts can run in zawk
